c74object.name: mUnit.loadbang
c74object.digest: Bang once the mUnit handler is ready, so test inputs are not sent too early
c74object.description: mUnit.loadbang bangs once, when mUnit.handler has started and been configured. A plain loadbang is too early: the node.script and v8 objects behind the framework are still starting, so an assert fed by it would miss its input. It works whether its patch loads before or after that moment, which makes it the right starting point in test patches opened by mUnit.harness. Each instance fires once, until it gets reset. The moment it fires is also when an assert's timeout starts counting and when mUnit.stimulus~ and mUnit.assert~ with trigger auto start.

inlet.digest: bang fires it now; reset re-arms it

outlet.digest: Bang once, when the handler is ready

method.name: bang
method.description: Sends a bang whether or not the handler is ready, for driving a test by hand.

method.name: reset
method.description: The object fires again at the next ready moment, or at once if the handler is already ready.

entry.name: bang
entry.description: Out the outlet: a bang, once, when the handler is ready, whether the patch opened before or after that moment.
